notes: Scan window 2026-11-13 through 2026-11-20, with contextual catch-up; 13 November publication included at window boundary.
All R1–R9 scanned using Consensus searches (rate-limited searches retried), publisher/arXiv primary records and named frontier/lab monitoring; quiet R7 preserved.

The realist synthesis identifies a measurement deficit, not a causal estimate; quasi-experiment has six intact class clusters; survey is cross-sectional; coordination study is a non-peer-reviewed preprint.
The Frontiers 10.3389/fpsyg.2026.2041306 accepted abstract lacks a verified final publication date and is excluded.
